title: Lakeland Financial Corporation 8-K Filing — Quarterly Cash Dividend Declaration
summary: Lakeland Financial Corporation, a regional bank holding company headquartered in Warsaw, Indiana (traded as LKFN on NASDAQ), filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.52 per share on common stock, payable May 5, 2026 to shareholders of record April 25, 2026.
key_points: Lakeland Financial Corporation declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.52 per share
